verdict.line: You win the all-in window before level 6 when E actually lands as a stun and Q's empowered autos chunk him, but you lose if the game drags past 20 minutes since Ornn's passive bonus resists and R threat outscale your damage, which is why the head-to-head sits at 44.7% over 85 games despite Sett holding the lane and solo-kill edge.

brief.thesis: Ornn has zero disengage before level 6 (Volcanic Rupture only slows, Searing Charge only knocks up on a wall), so Sett's E (Facebreaker, 16-10s CD) and Q (Knuckle Down, 9-5s CD) can force a real fight if you line up a minion on his far side for the stun. The sub-50% overall win rate comes later: Living Forge gives Ornn bonus Armor and Magic Resist from every item he buys, so your burst stops one-shotting proportionally as the game goes on.

theirWindow.when: After he lands Q poke, pre-level 6
theirWindow.what: Volcanic Rupture slams a fissure at 800 range and slows on hit, with only a 9-7s cooldown at early ranks. Don't trade autos into the slow window — back off to minions and let him walk forward to melee you, since that's where you win.

yourWindow.when: Levels 3-5, once E and Q are both up
yourWindow.what: Stand so a minion or ward is on Ornn's far side before you E — Facebreaker only stuns when enemies are pulled from opposite sides, and just slows if he's alone on one side. Land the stun, land two Q-empowered punches, and finish with Ignite before he can walk it off.

start.why: The highest-performing start in the data (45.5% WR, 73.3% pick) — the extra AD and sustain let you keep forcing E/Q trades level 1-3 without losing the lane-advantage window to poke damage.

boots.why: Top pick at 43.8% WR and 50.5% pick — Ornn deals magic damage, and tenacity keeps you mobile for the next E-stun setup instead of getting kited by Volcanic Rupture slows.

core.why: The highest-winning core path starts here (37.5% WR over 24 games) — the built-in slow proc lets you re-stick after an E stun so Ornn can't just walk out of Q range.
Armor shred from stacking autos directly offsets the bonus Armor Ornn's Living Forge passive keeps granting as he buys items.
Health plus magic damage reflection is the right answer to a melee champion whose kit is entirely magic damage.

situational.when: the game runs long and Ornn's stacked resists mean your all-ins need a damage-reduction shield to survive the counter-swing
ornn goes full tank and you need percent-health sustained damage instead of burst to actually kill him
the enemy jungler or mid is a heavy auto-attacker and you need the flat reduction more than magic resist

runes.keystoneWhy: The 63.2% win-rate page runs Conqueror over the alternative — stacking adaptive damage and healing off sustained melee hits is what lets you win the extended trades that Ornn's passive tankiness tries to turn into a stalemate.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 75.7% of games at a 46.9% win rate — Ignite converts your level 3-6 E-stun all-in into an actual kill before Ornn can walk it off or Flash away.

playing.title: Position E for the stun, not the slow
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns when enemies are caught from opposite sides — in a 1v1 that means angling so a minion, ward, or the wave itself sits on Ornn's far side before you cast it. Without that, E just slows him, and your all-in loses its lockdown.

playing.title: Save W for his commitment
playing.detail: Haymaker stores all damage you take as Grit and converts it into a shield plus a punch on cast. Let Ornn's Q or E hit you, then punch back immediately so his poke funds your own burst instead of just chipping you down.

playing.title: All-in by level 3-5, not level 1
playing.detail: You need E online to combo with Q's empowered autos. Don't trade autos before that — soak Volcanic Rupture pokes and wait for the full E-into-Q-into-Ignite window.

playing.title: Don't waste R into his W
playing.detail: The Show Stopper has a 120-80s cooldown and only a 400 range — commit it only when Ornn can't simply walk or dash out mid-channel. OP.GG's own data flags Bellows Breath as the common way this grab gets wasted, so hold it until he's already used his gap-closer.

playing.title: Respect his R once both are 6+
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God has 2500 range and a long travel time before it reaches Ornn — if you're caught by the elemental you eat damage, a slow, and Brittle, and he can recast to redirect it into you for a second hit.

playing.title: Stack Cleaver stacks on every trade
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's shred is the direct counter to Living Forge's bonus Armor — land your empowered Q autos consistently rather than saving them, since the shred is what keeps your damage relevant into his scaling resists.

playing.title: Don't force extended lane fights past 20 minutes
playing.detail: The 44.7% head-to-head win rate reflects exactly this: your early kill pressure doesn't carry into a straight stat-check once Ornn's items and passive resists stack up. Take your kills early and group off your lead instead of re-engaging him 1v1 late.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1) — the ability mechanics, timing windows, and tactical reasoning connecting them are this brief's own analysis, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Try to gain the upper hand by using [W] when Ornn uses his abilities. Be careful of having your [R] absorbed when he is using (W).
